rule: flash-attn 2.8.3.post1 csrc/flash_attn/flash_api.cpp:317 num_splits_heuristic(batch * num_heads * num_m_blocks, num_sm * 2, ...) returns 1 when its first argument >= 0.8 * (2 * SM); decode with GQA swaps the query groups into seqlen_q (flash_api.cpp:1278), so num_heads = H_kv and num_m_blocks = ceil(H_q / H_kv / 64) = 1 for every model below
